received_works.body:
Hello Iso_JinK-san,I love your costume designs and bright color styles and would like to request a dual outfit design for my OC couple!><

World Setting: A magical world inspired by the Victorian era, with a moderate level of technological development.

Character 1 (Top): Black Snake, 190cm
A cold and cunning character, deeply strategic and manipulative. He excel in controlling others and twisting fates, maintaining a calm exterior while hiding a dark, malicious nature.
Outfit Reference: Inspired by the Norse mythological serpent "Jörmungandr," embodying duality. I would love to see alternate head designs for different skin variations!
Design Elements: Spiral patterns, thorns, comets.

Character 2 (Bottom): Zachariah, 185cm
An intelligent and sensitive character, torn by inner struggles. He carry the pain of betrayal and loss, coupled with a yearning for revenge and a sense of helplessness.
Outfit Reference: Eastern European or Romanticist aesthetics.
Design Elements: Drama, tides.

Relationship Dynamic:
Black Snake is a curse that corrupts dreams and memories. It offers Zachariah hope, only to destroy it, with the ultimate goal of obtaining control over dreams and memories—a power passed down through Zachariah’s clan. Due to his exceptional talent, Zachariah has become Black Snake’s “perfect plaything.”
Through manipulation, Black Snake leads Zachariah step by step toward his fate—from establishing an intelligence network to uncovering the secrets of dreams—only to twist his consciousness and consume him entirely at the moment of revelation.

Feel free to unleash your creativity based on their profiles. If additional funds are required, I’d be more than happy to cover the cost.

Thank you so much for your time and consideration! Wishing you a Happy New Year!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12ZE4o-_7oZexvji0ibLGMrw9S8MgLbXC?usp=drive_link

Hello 忙人 sensei, I really love your artworks, especially your incredible sense for costumes. I would like to request a new design for my character Bourbon in a Western fantasy setting.  If the amount is not enough, please request a resend. However, if you find this subject is inappropriate, please feel free to cancel directly ^^.
Here is the character description:
Bourbon:
She is a vampire girl adopted by a wolf deity and placed in a tribe that worships this deity. She grew up on the vast grasslands and in the forests, becoming a skilled hunter and warrior. Her personality is straightforward and lively, always carrying a fearless smile and exuding a wild charm closely attuned to nature. She loves battle and adventure, adept with firearms and other weapons, excelling in both melee and ranged combat.

Character Traits
Height and Appearance: 155 cm tall, resembling a girl of 12–15 years. She has red eyes, white hair, pointed ears, and pale skin. Her right leg is a mechanical prosthetic engraved with mysterious patterns.
Personality: Bold and energetic, with a mischievous streak, yet deeply loyal to her tribe and the wolf deity. While she often appears carefree and unrestrained, her reliability shines through in critical moments.

Costume Design (For Reference)
I hope you will freely explore Bourbon's costume design, and the following details are provided only as inspiration. Please feel free to adjust or create as you see fit!
Overall Style: Inspired by the tribal aesthetics of nomadic cultures with a focus on practicality and agility. The design should reflect both her vampiric nature and her connection to the wolf deity, incorporating some metallic elements and rune-like details.
Costume Suggestions (Optional):
Upper Body: Leather short jacket or fur-trimmed armor, emphasizing mobility and protection.
Lower Body: Fitted pants or a battle skirt suitable for movement, with a belt to hold small ammo pouches or daggers.
Cloak: A short cape or mantle with wolf fur trimming or similar patterns symbolizing her bond with the wolf deity.
Footwear: Hunting boots or high boots adapted for various terrains.
Accessories (Optional):
Firearms or weapons decorated with wolf claws or rune patterns.
A wolf fang-shaped pendant or earrings, or hair accessories symbolizing the wolf deity.
Rune engravings or glowing magical sigils on her arms, knee guards, or mechanical prosthetic.

Symbolic Elements
Wolf Deity: Feel free to incorporate elements related to the wolf deity, such as fur, runes, or nature-inspired accessories, but these are entirely optional.
Nomadic Tribe: The costume may draw inspiration from the clothing of steppe tribes, incorporating tribal patterns or accents, though you are welcome to use any creative ideas that suit the character’s personality and background.

Please go as far as you can with this concept, design any costume or hairstyle as you like. Also, if you have any rough drafts or preliminary drawings, I would be happy to have them.
